name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Grayreach goes with at least one of Cody or Trout.
If Mabel goes with Catfish, then Bluegill goes with Cody.
Mabel goes with none of Bluegill, Trout, or Foxglen.
Exactly one of these is true: Cody goes with Catfish; Cody goes with Grayreach; Mabel goes with Grayreach.

From the clue “If Mabel goes with Catfish, then Bluegill goes with Cody” — Cody must go with Bluegill.
Cody goes with Bluegill, so it can't also go with Trout.
Bluegill goes with Cody, so Dale can't go with Bluegill.
In Angler × Species, Trout must go with Dale — every other Angler is already crossed out for it.
Suppose Mabel went with Grayreach — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Mabel goes with Grayreach.

…but now the clue “Grayreach goes with at least one of Cody or Trout” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Mabel does not go with Grayreach.
